It is unlocked at {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 7}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 7}} |A1 = Tessellated Ender Pearl, 4 |B1 = Null Blade |C1 = Tarantula Silk, 64 |A2 = Null Blade |B2 = Judgement Core |C2 = Braided Griffin Feather, 4 |A3 = Tessellated Ender Pearl, 4 |B3 = Null Blade |C3 = Tarantula Silk, 64 |Output = Terminator }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Bow |rarity = l |damage = +310 |strength = +50 |crit_damage = +250% |attack_speed = +40% |shot_cooldown = 0.5s |special_effect = Shoots {{cyan|3}} arrows at once.
Can damage endermen.
{{Red|Divides your {{stat|Crit Chance}} by 4!}} |ability_name = Shortbow: Instantly Shoots! |ability_shot_cooldown = 0.5s |item_ability_name = Salvation |item_ability_activation = Left Click |item_ability_description = Can be casted after landing {{Gold|3}} hits.
Shoot a beam, penetrating up to {{Yellow|5}} enemies.
The beam always crits. |item_ability_soulflow_cost = 1 |item_ability_cooldown = 0.25s }} The '''Terminator''' is a shortbow that is capable of hitting {{MobSprite|Enderman;Endermen}}. It fires {{Green|3}} arrows per shot: {{Green|1}} travels in the direction the player is looking at, and {{Green|2}} arrows fire at offset angles to either side. Spread is greatest when aiming horizontally and decreases as the player looks up or down. After landing {{Green|3}} hits on enemies, the {{AN|Salvation}} ability can be cast with {{Keypress|Left Click}}, costing {{Stat|soulflow|1}} and having a {{Green|0.25s}} cooldown. The beam has a range of {{Green|32}} blocks, can hit up to {{Green|5}} enemies, and is guaranteed to crit. While the '''Terminator''' is being held and the {{AN|Salvation}} ability is not on its cooldown, a colored text indicator appears on the action bar, indicating when the ability can be used. * {{Red|T1}} displays when {{Green|1}} hit has been landed. * {{Gold|T2}} displays when {{Green|2}} hits have been landed. * {{Green|T3!}} displays when {{Green|3}} hits have been landed and the ability is ready to be used. The '''Terminator''' divides the player's {{Stat|cc}} by {{Red|4}}. == Fire Rate == When left-clicking, the fire rate starts at 2.22 shots per second (9 ticks per shot) with {{Stat|bas|0}} and increases to 5 shots per second (4 ticks per shot) with {{Stat|bas|100}}.https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ATm1kO86bM0emKsuC7nAwazXDxNbEnkASSWSMjfIZc8/edit?usp=sharing The increase in fire rate with {{Stat|bas}} is incremental, not continuous. The maximum possible fire rate that can be achieved by optimal left-clicking depending on the player's {{Stat|bas}}: {| class="wikitable" ! rowspan="2" |Ticks per shot ! colspan="2" |{{Stat|bas}} ! rowspan="2" |Shots per second |- !Lowest !Highest |- !9 (0.45s) |< -8 |11 |2.22 |- !7 (0.35s) |12 |40 |2.86 |- !5 (0.25s) |41 |66 |4.00 |- !4 (0.20s) |67 |100 |5.00 |} == Essence Crafting == This weapon can be upgraded with Dragon Essence. Once converted, it requires {{Skill|Catacombs|27}} to use while in [[Catacombs]]. {{Essence Crafting |100 |200 |300 |500 |750 |convert = 300 |essence = Dragon |type = weapon }} == Trivia == *The
